# Fonts

Barlow and Barlow Condensed, by Jeremy Tribby, from [Google Fonts](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Barlow)
(github.com/google/fonts), under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`OFL.txt`): free to use, embed and ship in the game.

- BarlowCondensed-Bold.ttf, BarlowCondensed-SemiBold.ttf: headings, numbers, buttons
- Barlow-SemiBold.ttf, Barlow-Medium.ttf, Barlow-Regular.ttf: text to read

`UI/Game.uss` sets them.
